visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with shoulder-length brown hair, dressed in a brown plaid oversized blazer and a white shirt, stands in a brightly lit indoor parking garage. She looks at the camera with an animated smile, her facial expressions showing excitement. The background features white concrete pillars, red pipes on the ceiling, and a distant red car. (2) She raises a black rectangular Volvo key fob to the frame, holding it between her thumb and forefinger to showcase the brand logo. Her eyes are bright and focused on the camera. The setting remains the industrial-looking parking facility with even overhead lighting. (3) The woman turns and walks toward a white Volvo EX30 parked in the distance. As she gets closer, the car's headlights flash in a welcome sequence. She is seen from behind and the side, highlighting her casual-professional attire against the grey garage floor. (4) The scene shifts to the woman inside the vehicle's driver seat. She has both hands on the steering wheel while driving through an urban street environment. Visible outside the windows are city buildings and trees under overcast daylight. The car's interior features a minimalist design with a large vertical touchscreen. (5) A montage of close-up shots displays the car's exterior details, including the 'Thor's Hammer' LED headlights, the front grille, and the frameless side mirrors. The lighting is bright and natural, reflecting off the white metallic paint of the vehicle. (6) The camera focuses on the interior 'Breeze' blue upholstery and the textured dashboard with shimmering star-like particles. A close-up reveals the Harman Kardon soundbar integrated into the dashboard. The woman's hands are seen interacting with the central touchscreen which displays a navigation map. (7) She is shown opening the rear trunk by pressing a button, revealing a spacious cargo area with an additional lower storage compartment. Later, she is back in the driver's seat, pulling down the sun visor and looking into the vanity mirror. (8) The video concludes with a full profile shot of the white Volvo EX30 parked in a clean, studio-like environment with a curved white wall. Yellow wheel chocks are placed on the ground, and the car's lighting is fully illuminated.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A vibrant female voice begins speaking in a high-arousal, cheerful tone. The BGM is an upbeat electronic pop track with a prominent synth melody and a steady 4/4 electronic drum beat. The atmosphere is energetic and clean. (2) A subtle 'click' sound effect coincides with the key fob being mentioned. The speaker maintains a high speech rate with bright inflection. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (3) A distinct 'beep-thud' sound represents the car doors unlocking. The acoustics shift slightly to reflect a more open garage space with a touch of reverb. (4) Transitioning to the drive, a faint urban ambient floor with distant traffic hum is audible beneath the voice. The BGM swells slightly during a music-only bridge between sentences. (5) Rapid 'whoosh' sound effects are used during the exterior montage to punctuate visual cuts. The speaker's tone remains authoritative yet friendly, detailing technical specs with high articulation clarity. (6) A soft mechanical 'snap' is heard as storage lids are opened inside the car. The vocal tone becomes more casual and expressive. (7) A percussive 'ding' sound effect highlights the text appearing on screen. The BGM continues its high-energy loop until the final brand slogan where it begins a rapid fade.
